pairs.target: mǐlā cóng mùliào xiāng lǐ tuō chū yìgēn wāi mùtiáo , fàngdào tǎ wéi miànqián , shuō zhè jiùshì tā de qiáo .
pairs.english: Mira dragged a crooked strip of wood from the timber box and laid it in front of Tavi, saying this was her bridge.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉从木料箱里拖出一根歪木条，放到塔维面前，说这就是她的桥。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ tā fānguòlái , kànjiàn bèimiàn háiyǒu yídào jù wāi de kǒuzǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi turned it over and saw a crooked saw cut on the back as well.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把它翻过来，看见背面还有一道锯歪的口子。

pairs.target: " nǐ diē zhīdào ma ? "
pairs.english: “Does your father know?”
pairs.hanzi: “你爹知道吗？”

pairs.target: " děng tā néng zhànzhù zài gàosù tā . "
pairs.english: “I'll tell him once it can stand.”
pairs.hanzi: “等它能站住再告诉他。”

pairs.target: běi gōngfáng wǔhòu de kōng zhuō kěyǐ jiè dào wǎnfàn qián .
pairs.english: The empty tables in the north workshop could be borrowed in the afternoons until dinner.
pairs.hanzi: 北工房午后的空桌可以借到晚饭前。

pairs.target: sāntiān qián tiē chū de dōng zuò xiǎo zhǎn gàoshì hái guà zài ménwài ,
pairs.english: The notice for a small winter-work exhibition, posted three days ago, was still hanging outside.
pairs.hanzi: 三天前贴出的冬作小展告示还挂在门外，

pairs.target: búsuàn kǎohé , yuànyì ná dōngxī lái bǎi jiù xiě gè míngzì .
pairs.english: It wasn't an assessment; anyone who wanted to display something could put down their name.
pairs.hanzi: 不算考核，愿意拿东西来摆就写个名字。

pairs.target: yǒurén xiǎng zuò dēngzhào , yǒurén zhī xiě le " zànshí bǎomì ",
pairs.english: Someone wanted to make a lampshade; someone else had written only “a secret for now,”
pairs.hanzi: 有人想做灯罩，有人只写了“暂时保密”，

pairs.target: xiàmiàn yǐjīng bèi tiān le sāncì wènhào .
pairs.english: under which question marks had already been added three times.
pairs.hanzi: 下面已经被添了三次问号。

pairs.target: mǐlā jièlái liǎnggè mùkuài zuò qiáodūn , bǎ mùtiáo jià zài shàngmiàn .
pairs.english: Mira borrowed two wooden blocks for bridge piers and rested the strip across them.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉借来两个木块做桥墩，把木条架在上面。

pairs.target: tā gěi tā kàn cóng cángpǐn shì chāo lái de qiáo zuò tú ,
pairs.english: She showed him the bridge-bearing drawing copied from the collection room,
pairs.hanzi: 她给他看从藏品室抄来的桥座图，

pairs.target: zhǐzhe liáng dǐ hé shítái zhījiān nàge bùqǐyǎn de dìfāng .
pairs.english: pointing to the inconspicuous place between the underside of the beam and the stone platform.
pairs.hanzi: 指着梁底和石台之间那个不起眼的地方。

pairs.target: dàqiáo yùdào lěngrè , liáng huì yǒu hěnxiǎo de shēnsuō ,
pairs.english: In hot and cold weather a large bridge's beam would expand and contract slightly;
pairs.hanzi: 大桥遇到冷热，梁会有很小的伸缩，

pairs.target: zhī zhe liáng de dìfāng bùnéng quán bǎ tā yǎo sǐ .
pairs.english: the places supporting it must not all grip it rigidly.
pairs.hanzi: 支着梁的地方不能全把它咬死。

pairs.target: tā shuō zhèhuà shí méiyǒu kàn tú ,
pairs.english: She wasn't looking at the drawing as she said this.
pairs.hanzi: 她说这话时没有看图，

pairs.target: shǒuzhǐ zài zhuōshàng tuī le yíxià , fǎngfú nàtiáo xìxiàn yǐjīng yǒu le zhòngliàng .
pairs.english: Her finger pushed across the table, as though that fine line already had weight.
pairs.hanzi: 手指在桌上推了一下，仿佛那条细线已经有了重量。

pairs.target: " wǒ yào ràng rén zhàn zài zhuōbiān , yě néng kànjiàn tā zěnme dòng . "
pairs.english: “I want people standing beside the table to be able to see how it moves.”
pairs.hanzi: “我要让人站在桌边，也能看见它怎么动。”

pairs.target: tā de móxíng búhuì zhēn kào wūlǐ de wēnchā shēnsuō .
pairs.english: Her model would not actually expand and contract with the room's temperature changes.
pairs.hanzi: 她的模型不会真靠屋里的温差伸缩。

pairs.target: mùtiáo yìtóu cáng zhe néng lādòng de xiǎo duàn , shǒu wǎng wài tuī , jiù dàitì liáng biàn cháng ;
pairs.english: One end of the strip concealed a small movable section; pushing it outward by hand would stand in for the beam lengthening.
pairs.hanzi: 木条一头藏着能拉动的小段，手往外推，就代替梁变长；

pairs.target: dǐxià de huázuò gāi gēnzhe zǒu , qiáodūn què bùnéng bèi tuōdǎo .
pairs.english: The sliding bearing beneath it should move along, without pulling the piers over.
pairs.hanzi: 底下的滑座该跟着走，桥墩却不能被拖倒。

pairs.target: tā xiǎng ràng huázuò lù zài wàimiàn , lián kǎzhù shí shì shénmeyàng dōu kàndéjiàn .
pairs.english: She wanted to leave the bearing exposed so even what happened when it jammed would be visible.
pairs.hanzi: 她想让滑座露在外面，连卡住时是什么样都看得见。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tīngdào zhèlǐ , xiǎngqǐ qiánxiētiān zìjǐ de liǎngshēng .
pairs.english: Hearing this, Tavi remembered his two clicks a few days earlier.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维听到这里，想起前些天自己的两声。

pairs.target: tā bǎ mùtiáo ànzhù , shuō kěyǐ zài xiàmiàn jiā liǎngpiàn tiě ,
pairs.english: He held the strip down and said they could add two iron plates beneath it,
pairs.hanzi: 他把木条按住，说可以在下面加两片铁，

pairs.target: ràng yípiàn gèng róngyì wān , nálái yǎnshì ràngwèi .
pairs.english: making one easier to bend to demonstrate yielding.
pairs.hanzi: 让一片更容易弯，拿来演示让位。

pairs.target: mǐlā yáotóu .
pairs.english: Mira shook her head.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉摇头。

pairs.target: " wǒ xiǎng zuò búyòng jiè xìng yě néngdòng de . "
pairs.english: “I want to make something that moves without borrowing.”
pairs.hanzi: “我想做不用借性也能动的。”

pairs.target: tā sōngkāi shǒu , mùtiáo piān le yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: He let go, and the strip tilted a little.
pairs.hanzi: 他松开手，木条偏了一点。

pairs.target: mǐlā jiē zhù , yòu shuō tā nàge bànfǎ kěyǐ lìng zuò yíjiàn , tā zhèjiàn xiǎng xiān àn yuánlái de tú shì .
pairs.english: Mira caught it and added that his idea could be a separate piece; she wanted to try hers according to the original drawing first.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉接住，又说他那个办法可以另做一件，她这件想先按原来的图试。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō zhīdào .
pairs.english: Tavi said he understood.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说知道。

pairs.target: tā de shēngyīn bǐ zìjǐ dǎsuàn de duǎn , suíjí juéde nánkān .
pairs.english: His voice came out shorter than he had intended, and he immediately felt ashamed.
pairs.hanzi: 他的声音比自己打算的短，随即觉得难堪。

pairs.target: míngmíng xiān kāikǒu jiào tā lái de búshì lǎoshī , shì mǐlā ;
pairs.english: It had plainly been Mira who invited him, not a teacher;
pairs.hanzi: 明明先开口叫他来的不是老师，是米拉；

pairs.target: tā què xiàng yǐjīng dài zhe yígè bǐ tā hǎo de zhǔyì jìn le mén .
pairs.english: yet he had acted as though he had already come through the door with a better idea than hers.
pairs.hanzi: 他却像已经带着一个比她好的主意进了门。

pairs.target: mǐlā méiyǒu jìxù jiěshì .
pairs.english: Mira did not go on explaining.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉没有继续解释。

pairs.target: tā bǎ yìxiǎo lán biānjiǎoliào tuī lái , wèn nǎxiē tiěpí zhé biān yǐhòu bù róngyì liè .
pairs.english: She pushed over a small basket of offcuts and asked which sheets of iron would be less likely to crack after their edges were bent.
pairs.hanzi: 她把一小篮边角料推来，问哪些铁皮折边以后不容易裂。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi fān le jǐpiàn , bǎ yíkuài xiù xiàmiàn qǐ céng de fàngdào pángbiān ,
pairs.english: Tavi turned over a few sheets, set aside one that was flaking beneath the rust,
pairs.hanzi: 塔维翻了几片，把一块锈下面起层的放到旁边，

pairs.target: yòu zhǎodào liǎngpiàn kuānzhǎi héshì de , shuō dé xiān xiū diào máobiān .
pairs.english: and found two of suitable width, saying the burrs would need removing first.
pairs.hanzi: 又找到两片宽窄合适的，说得先修掉毛边。

pairs.target: " nà nǐ zuò zhège . wǒ jùmù tou . "
pairs.english: “Then you make this. I'll saw the wood.”
pairs.hanzi: “那你做这个。我锯木头。”

pairs.target: jù shēng yìqǐ , tā jiù méifǎ zài xiǎng nà jù jùjué .
pairs.english: Once the sawing began, he could no longer keep thinking about her refusal.
pairs.hanzi: 锯声一起，他就没法再想那句拒绝。

pairs.target: mǐlā de jiǎo cǎizhù mùliào , jiānbǎng suízhe jùzǐ wǎngfǎn .
pairs.english: Mira pinned the wood with her foot, her shoulder moving back and forth with the saw.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉的脚踩住木料，肩膀随着锯子往返。

pairs.target: mùfěn luò zài xié jiān shàng , tā yě bù dǒu ,
pairs.english: Sawdust fell on her shoe tips, but she did not shake it off.
pairs.hanzi: 木粉落在鞋尖上，她也不抖，

pairs.target: zhī zài kuài duàn shí jiào tā tuō yíxià , miǎnde zuìhòu nà diǎn mùtou bēngdiào .
pairs.english: Only as the cut neared the end did she ask him to support it so the last bit of wood would not split away.
pairs.hanzi: 只在快断时叫他托一下，免得最后那点木头崩掉。

pairs.target: tā mó hǎo tiěpí , zhào tā huà de kuāndù zhé chū yìzhī qiǎnqiǎnde cáo .
pairs.english: He smoothed the iron sheet and bent it into a shallow channel of the width she had drawn.
pairs.hanzi: 他磨好铁皮，照她画的宽度折出一只浅浅的槽。

pairs.target: mùtou zuò de huákuài fàngjìnqù , tuī dé dòng , què huàng dé lìhài .
pairs.english: The wooden slider moved when placed inside, but wobbled badly.
pairs.hanzi: 木头做的滑块放进去，推得动，却晃得厉害。

pairs.target: tā zhèngyào bǎ liǎngbiān wǎng lǐ shōu , mǐlā shēnshǒu lán le .
pairs.english: He was about to close the two sides inward when Mira reached out to stop him.
pairs.hanzi: 他正要把两边往里收，米拉伸手拦了。

pairs.target: " xiān ràng wǒ kànkàn . "
pairs.english: “Let me look first.”
pairs.hanzi: “先让我看看。”

pairs.target: tā dūn dào zhuō yán xiàmiàn , yǎnjīng hé cáo dǐ qípíng , kàn le hěn jiǔ .
pairs.english: She crouched below the table edge, her eyes level with the channel bottom, and looked for a long time.
pairs.hanzi: 她蹲到桌沿下面，眼睛和槽底齐平，看了很久。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yě dūnxiàqù , liǎnggè rén de étóu chàdiǎn zhuàng shàng .
pairs.english: Tavi crouched too, and their foreheads nearly collided.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维也蹲下去，两个人的额头差点撞上。

pairs.target: tā wénjiàn tā xiùkǒu yǒu xīn mùtou de qìwèi .
pairs.english: He could smell fresh wood at her cuff.
pairs.hanzi: 他闻见她袖口有新木头的气味。

pairs.target: yuánlái cáo dǐ búshì píng de , zhōngjiān gǔ le yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: The channel bottom wasn't flat after all: it bulged slightly in the middle.
pairs.hanzi: 原来槽底不是平的，中间鼓了一点。

pairs.target: yuè bǎ biān shōujǐn , huákuài yuè huì qí zài nà diǎn tūqǐ shàng .
pairs.english: The tighter they closed the sides, the more the slider would ride on that bulge.
pairs.hanzi: 越把边收紧，滑块越会骑在那点凸起上。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ tā qǔchū lái , huàn le kuài píng mù diàn zhe qiāo .
pairs.english: Tavi took it out and hammered it against a different, flat wooden backing.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把它取出来，换了块平木垫着敲。

pairs.target: zài fàngjìnqù shí , huàngdòng xiǎo le , réng huì zǒu wāi .
pairs.english: When they put it back, it wobbled less but still ran crooked.
pairs.hanzi: 再放进去时，晃动小了，仍会走歪。

pairs.target: tāmen wèi zhèdiǎn wāi zhēng le bàntiān .
pairs.english: They argued over that crooked movement for ages.
pairs.hanzi: 他们为这点歪争了半天。

pairs.target: mǐlā shuō liǎngcè yào yíyàng gāo , tǎ wéi shuō guāng yíyàng gāo yě búgòu .
pairs.english: Mira said the sides needed to be the same height; Tavi said equal height alone wasn't enough.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉说两侧要一样高，塔维说光一样高也不够。

pairs.target: hòulái tā yòng zhǐjiǎ dǐzhù huákuài yícè , tā zài tuī , mùkuài jìng hěn shùn dì huá le guòqù .
pairs.english: Finally she held her fingernail against one side of the slider. When he pushed again, the block slid smoothly along.
pairs.hanzi: 后来她用指甲抵住滑块一侧，他再推，木块竟很顺地滑了过去。

pairs.target: " zài jiā gè cè dǎng . " tā shuō .
pairs.english: “Add a side guide,” she said.
pairs.hanzi: “再加个侧挡。”她说。

pairs.target: " nǐ zhègēn shǒuzhǐ jiè wǒ bǎi zhǎn shàng . "
pairs.english: “Lend me that finger of yours to put in the exhibition.”
pairs.hanzi: “你这根手指借我摆展上。”

pairs.target: " měitiān gòng sāndùn fàn . "
pairs.english: “Three meals a day.”
pairs.hanzi: “每天供三顿饭。”

pairs.target: yīwén lái de shíhòu , cè dǎng hái zhǐyǒu bànjié .
pairs.english: When Iven arrived, the guide was still only half done.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文来的时候，侧挡还只有半截。

pairs.target: tā zài ménkǒu pāidiào kùjiǎo de huī , shuō zìjǐ zhǐyǒu yíkèzhōng , wǎnshàng héchàng yào xiān dào .
pairs.english: He brushed dust from his trouser legs in the doorway and said he had only a quarter of an hour; he had to arrive early for choir that evening.
pairs.hanzi: 他在门口拍掉裤脚的灰，说自己只有一刻钟，晚上合唱要先到。

pairs.target: tā gěi mù zuò biān de xiǎo zhǐtiáo xiě le liǎngzhǒng zìhào ,
pairs.english: He wrote two lettering sizes on the small label beside the wooden base.
pairs.hanzi: 他给木座边的小纸条写了两种字号，

pairs.target: mǐlā xuǎn dà de , shuō láikàn qiáo de rén búyòng xiān pāxià .
pairs.english: Mira chose the larger, saying people shouldn't have to lie down before looking at the bridge.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉选大的，说来看桥的人不用先趴下。

pairs.target: yīwén kàn le yíbiàn tāmen de yǎnshì , zhǐzhe " qiáoliáng shēncháng " sìgè zì ,
pairs.english: Iven watched their demonstration once, pointed to the four characters for “the beam lengthens,”
pairs.hanzi: 伊文看了一遍他们的演示，指着“桥梁伸长”四个字，

pairs.target: wèn yào buyào shuōmíng zhè shì yòng shǒutuī chūlái de .
pairs.english: and asked whether they should explain it was being pushed by hand.
pairs.hanzi: 问要不要说明这是用手推出来的。

pairs.target: mǐlā shuō yào , bié ràng rén yǐwéi tā ná le yì jié huì zìjǐ cháng de mùtou lái .
pairs.english: Mira said yes: they mustn't let people think she had brought a piece of wood that grew by itself.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉说要，别让人以为她拿了一截会自己长的木头来。

pairs.target: tā xiě wán , tǎ wéi qǐng tā zài tuī yícì .
pairs.english: After he finished writing, Tavi asked him to push it again.
pairs.hanzi: 他写完，塔维请他再推一次。

pairs.target: zhè yícì huákuài kǎzhù le .
pairs.english: This time the slider jammed.
pairs.hanzi: 这一次滑块卡住了。

pairs.target: sāngè rén dōu dīng zhe nà zhī tíng zài bànlù de shǒu .
pairs.english: All three stared at the hand stopped halfway along.
pairs.hanzi: 三个人都盯着那只停在半路的手。

pairs.target: yīwén mànmàn shōuhuí shǒuzhǐ , shuō zìjǐ de běnshì zànshí zhī dào zhèlǐ .
pairs.english: Iven slowly withdrew his fingers and said this was as far as his talents currently reached.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文慢慢收回手指，说自己的本事暂时只到这里。

pairs.target: mǐlā xiān xiào , jiēzhe pā dào zhuōshàng , xiào dé méifǎ qù ná xiǎo chuí .
pairs.english: Mira laughed first, then folded over the table, laughing too hard to pick up the little hammer.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉先笑，接着趴到桌上，笑得没法去拿小锤。

pairs.target: yīwén zǒu hòu , tāmen bǎ zhǐtiáo yā zài chuāng biān jìxù xiū .
pairs.english: After Iven left, they weighted the label down by the window and went on working.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文走后，他们把纸条压在窗边继续修。

pairs.target: gāngcái bùzhī shuí pèng piān le dǐbǎn , yìkē mùxiè yòu jǐjìn cáo lǐ .
pairs.english: Someone had nudged the base out of line earlier, and a wood chip had also wedged itself into the channel.
pairs.hanzi: 刚才不知谁碰偏了底板，一颗木屑又挤进槽里。

alignment.english: nudged the base out of line

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tīchū mùxiè shí , mǐlā bǎ qiáodūn huà dào fèizhǐ shàng , chóngxīn xiǎng liǎngtóu zěnme gùdìng .
pairs.english: While Tavi picked out the chip, Mira drew the piers on scrap paper, rethinking how to secure both ends.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维剔出木屑时，米拉把桥墩画到废纸上，重新想两头怎么固定。

pairs.target: wǎnfàn de zhōngxiǎng le , qiáo hái méiyǒu quán zhànwěn .
pairs.english: The dinner bell rang, and the bridge was not entirely stable yet.
pairs.hanzi: 晚饭的钟响了，桥还没有全站稳。

pairs.target: tāmen gěi zhuōshàng wèi wán de dōngxī gài le yíkuài bù ,
pairs.english: They covered the unfinished work on the table with a cloth.
pairs.hanzi: 他们给桌上未完的东西盖了一块布，

pairs.target: tiě cáo liúzài bù wài , xiàng lùchū yì jié xié jiān .
pairs.english: The iron channel remained outside it, like the tip of a shoe poking out.
pairs.hanzi: 铁槽留在布外，像露出一截鞋尖。

pairs.target: zǒu dào ménkǒu , tǎ wéi huítóu kàn le yìyǎn . mǐlā wèn tā míngtiān hái lái bu lái .
pairs.english: At the door, Tavi glanced back. Mira asked whether he would come again tomorrow.
pairs.hanzi: 走到门口，塔维回头看了一眼。米拉问他明天还来不来。

pairs.target: tā shuō míngtiān dé xiān xǐyī , xǐwán jiù lái .
pairs.english: He said he had laundry to do first tomorrow, but would come afterward.
pairs.hanzi: 他说明天得先洗衣，洗完就来。

pairs.target: tā shuō nà hǎo , tā xiān bǎ lìngyìbiān jù chūlái .
pairs.english: She said good; she would saw out the other side first.
pairs.hanzi: 她说那好，她先把另一边锯出来。
